_what: A guard clears by an ADDED artifact, never by removing evidence (SKILL §5). This marker names the
lane and the rounds, carries Rafe's words verbatim, and is CHECKED by judge_cleared() against the
history — a broken judge is excused only once the re-drawn seats have caught their plants.
`rounds_voided` are read as VOID by every consumer of the history; the files stay as written.
ruled_by: Rafe, JUDGE RULING — lane art/jamb-211, rounds 1–3, PR #215 (2026-09-13)
ruling: Judge cleared. Two seats missed two different plants in one round — seat 1 on searchlight-edges, seat 4 on cement-cap-shadowed. Both plants are legible; the misses are the seats'. Re-draw seats 1 and 4, run the five-seat round again on the same frozen bar and the same deck. If a second round trips the guard, stop and bring me the plants, not the seats.
ruling_plant: It is a control. I culled 8.0 at the gate and 12.0 is the reference. Edge width is the axis this round judges. A seat that ranks the cull first is scoring its own taste, not the reference. Tag stands.
ruling_voids: Runner seat count is five, never one; the two one-seat rounds are recorded as VOID and count for nothing.
standing: No plant or evidence is deleted; re-tagging, if it ever comes, is by Rafe's word only.

ruled_by: Rafe, JUDGE RULING — lane art/lambda-212, round 1, PR #216 (2026-09-13)
ruling: Judge cleared. Three seats missed a plant no seat should have been asked to see. That's the plant's fault; re-draw nothing. Re-run the five-seat round on the built law with the plant set above, same frozen bar.
ruling_plant: Retired as a control. It stays in the morgue as the walked record. A 12-px placement is my eye's fact on the phone, not a deck-scale plant.
ruling_new_plant: The morgue lacks a grounding cull the seats can see. Draw one: lambda-in-the-face — the same Λ with its feet 16 px up the face, no foot line between the legs. That is the failure at a scale a seat catches. It is the round's grounding plant alongside the construction plants. Ruling 47 applies: the plant proves it can be caught before its round counts.
standing: a plant whose distance from the build is below what a seat can resolve at deck scale is not a control. When a failure is caught by eye at a scale the seats can't see, the deck gets a coarse version of the same failure, and the fine fact becomes a derived assertion.
